Peacemaker on Discord:

For convenience, I will include the Skelet #1-normalized starting tape for each machine.
The behavior of the machines is essentially running Skelet #1 with these starting tapes.

============

1RB0LB_1LA0LC_1RF1LD_0RE0LG_---1RC_1RG1RD_1LC0RC
0^inf 1 <C 001 0^inf (sk1 normalized)
These five machines use different starting tapes, but they all converge before 200 steps
and go on the same alternate trajectory which I will call Trajectory X.
================
1LB1RB_1RA0RC_1LD0RD_1RE1LF_1RC1RF_0RG0LC_---1RD
0^inf 110 B> 1 0^inf (sk1 normalized)
This machine goes on a unique trajectory (Trajectory Y).
================
1LB0RB_1RA1RC_---1RD_1RE1LG_1RF1RG_1LD0RD_0RC0LF
0^inf 101 E> 1 0^inf (sk1 normalized)
This machine also goes on a unique trajectory (Trajectory Z).
